content:
olivia: User reported two linked pains after upgrading to v2: 1) Vercel Edge deploy fails with `TypeError: require is not defined`. 2) TS overload errors when calling `createClient()` with no args.
ben: Sounds like ESM/CJS mismatch + typings regressions. Do they have `type: "module"` but some samples still use `require()`?
harpreet: Yes. Quickstart had mixed examples. Edge is ESM-only so `require` will throw. We need to ensure our package publishes an ESM entry and exports field with both import/require.
olivia: Also their TS error: `TS2769: No overload matches this call` for `createClient()`. Our overloads require a model in one branch which breaks inference.
ben: Proposed ergonomic signature: `function createClient<T = any>(opts?: ClientOptions & { model?: T }): Client<T>`. That gives a usable default for callers who don't want to specify model generics. Add `createStrictClient<T extends Model>(opts: ClientOptions & { model: T }): Client<T>` for strict flows.
harpreet: For the `unknown` vs `any` debate: keep `unknown` internally, but export friendly aliases: `type SDKResponse<T = any> = ResponsePayload<T>` and helpers like `parseResponse<T = any>(r: SDKResponse<T>): T`. That prevents forcing casts for common use.
olivia: Runtime guidance: avoid top-level `process.env` reads and Buffer usage. Use guards like `const KEY = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env.KEY : (globalThis as any).__REDWOOD_KEY`. Also avoid sync fs in examples.
ben: Docs: add tsconfig snippet recommending `module: ESNext`, `moduleResolution: bundler`, `target: ES2020` and a package.json exports example: "exports": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }.
harpreet: Action items: 1) add permissive no-arg overload and ergonomic generic defaults, 2) publish ESM build + update exports, 3) add minimal Vercel Edge example using `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/esm'`, 4) update migration docs re: `unknown` vs `any`.
olivia: I'll draft a small repro and PR. @devex-bot please open an issue "sdk: types + ESM/CJS parity (Edge repro)" and link this thread.
devex-bot: Created issue #3502: "sdk: types + ESM/CJS parity (Edge repro)" and linked this thread.
ben: Also add CI tests: matrix of TS versions + a lint rule to reject `require(` in `examples/edge-*`.
harpreet: Good. Once PR lands update quickstart and migration guide.
olivia: Drafting PR now, will ping for review.
